verdict.summary: The production-write-path self-test is sound and non-vacuous. It drives the live write seam through the process boundary, requires exactly three successful writes and a completed rescue, checks exact executed argv shapes (including the SHA-bound GraphQL relatch), excludes arm/admin/label hazards, and verifies minted-token propagation with GH_DEBUG scrubbed. It also directly pins return-code and stdout normalization. The non-zero disarm case verifies error propagation and no rescue booking; the pre-existing flow test independently pins marker/disarm/relatch failure sequencing. Cleanup restores subprocess.run and GH_DEBUG on all paths. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect is evident. Findings remain empty as in round 1.
